source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Build both lists in the app with a single shared limit for Epic Heroes, unique datasheets, Enhancements and other once-per-army picks. Each such choice can appear once per team. An Upgrade may repeat inside one list if standard mustering permits it. The same Upgrade cannot appear on both lists, even if the players share detachments. Pick a Character from either army as the team’s sole Warlord. Choose one Force Disposition that either army can use and enter it on the roster. Teammates may use matching or different faction keywords and detachment selections. Check the Doubles terminology and core changes for the implications, then finish the remaining mission setup steps.

appliesTo: datasheets limited to one per army
